name: Add MCP Tool to Vessel
description: Add a new MCP tool to a vessel. Reads existing tool definitions, adds the new tool with proper schema, and registers the handler.

tasks.description: Read existing tool definitions to understand patterns

prompt.template:
Read the existing tool definitions in {{vesselPath}}/src/tools.ts to understand:

1. How tools are defined (schema structure)
2. How handlers are registered
3. Common patterns for input validation
4. Error handling patterns

Read the file and create /tmp/tool-analysis-{{toolName}}.md with:

```markdown
# Tool Pattern Analysis

## Tool Definition Structure
[How tools are defined]

## Handler Structure
[How handlers work]

## Input Validation
[How inputs are validated]

## Error Handling
[How errors are handled]
```

tasks.description: Add the tool definition with JSON schema
